definition.en: Inflation is defined as a sustained increase in the general price level of goods and services in an economy over a period of time, leading to a decline in the purchasing power of money.
definition.hi: Inflation is defined as a sustained increase in the general price level of goods and services in an economy over a period of time, leading to a decline in the purchasing power of money.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding the causes of inflation is critical for UPSC GS-3 as it directly impacts monetary policy, fiscal management, and the cost of living. Aspirants must analyze how supply-side constraints and demand-side pressures influence the Indian economy to answer questions on RBI's inflation targeting and government interventions.

learningOutcomes.en: Identify the primary drivers of inflation including demand-pull and cost-push factors.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the role of structural bottlenecks and monetary expansion in the Indian context.
